rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or considering something only at the surface level.

example.english: Superficially, everyone said there was no problem, but they were furious inside.
example.traditional: 表面上大家都話冇問題，其實心入面一肚氣。
example.jyutping: biu2 min6 soeng6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 waa6 mou5 man6 tai4 kei4 sat6 sam1 jap6 min6 jat1 tou5 hei3

rows.note: Use this when the superficial treatment is cursory or incomplete, such as looking over something quickly.

example.english: I only looked over the report superficially and haven't yet noticed how many errors it contains.
example.traditional: 我粗略咁睇過份報告，仲未發現入面有幾多錯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cou1 loek6 gam3 tai2 gwo3 fan2 bou3 gou3 zung6 mei6 faat3 jin6 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 do1 co3
